id.description: The internal ID of the submitted item (returned only when type is submission)

url.description: The URL of the S3 file or Google Drive file

questions.description: An array of questions for the requested page

page_number.description: The page number, returned only if there is a previous or next page

user_status.description: The user status information for the current test

status.description: The current quiz status for this user

score.description: The current calculated score for the user

evaluation_status.description: If status is submitted, this contains the evaluation status

suspension_time.description: How many minutes the user should wait before the test is unsuspended

time_consumed.description: Tracks the amount of time consumed by the user

attempts_consumed.description: Tracks the number of attempts consumed by the user

feedback_message.description: An optional message that depends on the actual user score

score_per_category.description: An optional array containing the calculated scores divided by category

average_user_score.description: The average score of other users who have already completed the test

show_results.description: Returns TRUE if the results should be displayed, otherwise returns FALSE

is_completed.description: Returns TRUE if the question is completed, otherwise returns FALSE
